Synopsis:
    US index futures are rebounding premarket ahead of a pivotal CPI report, after a week of losses driven by elevated Treasury yields (10Y near 4.94%), a hotter-than-expected PPI, surging energy prices (Brent >$104, WTI near $100, diesel at a record $6+/gallon), and intensifying Middle East conflict. Oracle's strong AI-driven earnings lifted sentiment. The key near-term risk is whether CPI confirms the inflation resurgence signaled by PPI, which could force the Fed's hand and weigh further on equities. Adobe disappointed on guidance. Historically, strong YTD gains through August tend to persist into year-end per Franklin Templeton data.
